message.content:
Total marbles: \(3+4+5=12\).

If we count unordered draws of 3 marbles:

\[
\text{Total outcomes}=\binom{12}{3}=220
\]

To get exactly one of each colour:

\[
\text{Favourable outcomes}=\binom{3}{1}\binom{4}{1}\binom{5}{1}=3\cdot4\cdot5=60
\]

So the probability is

\[
\frac{60}{220}=\frac{3}{11}
\]

**Answer:** \(\boxed{\frac{3}{11}}\)
